title: Rich text multi-run formatting: only first run styling kept on FLA import
description: flash8-binary.ts line 1728-1729: when a text field has multiple formatting runs, only the first run's formatting is kept (if (!run) run = thisRun) while subsequent runs' styling is discarded. Text content is concatenated correctly but per-run font/size/color styling is lost. Requires extending Fla8Text with runs[] field and model/SWF encoder support.
